name: Condescension Of God
overview: The Scriptures reveal God's condescension as He engages personally and compassionately with His creation, reasoning with figures like Abraham and Moses to reveal His purposes and extend mercy. For example, God appeared to Abraham to assure and covenant with him, and He patiently reasoned with Abraham over the fate of Sodom. God also communicated directly with Abimelech in a dream to protect His covenant plan, and He instructed Moses in ways that demonstrated His intimate involvement in guiding His people. These instances highlight God's gracious willingness to lower Himself to converse with and guide humanity according to His righteous will.
